items.headline: Hong Kong mother and son jailed in Singapore over violent clash at Changi Airport
items.summary: A 42-year-old man and his 65-year-old mother were sentenced after the son kicked her at a Changi Airport terminal, then assaulted a bystander and bit a police officer who intervened.

items.headline: Netanyahu publicly rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza peace plan
items.summary: Netanyahu said Israel rejects the US-backed plan, insisting Hamas disarm fully before any Israeli withdrawal and ruling out a Palestinian state, opening a rare public rift with Trump.

items.headline: Update: Ukrainian drone strike on Tatarstan refinery kills 13 in deadliest attack in two years
items.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk killed 13 and wounded about 75, hitting the Taneco refinery; Kyiv also struck a Saratov refinery the same night.

items.headline: Iran replaces national security chief as Strait of Hormuz talks stall
items.summary: Iran's supreme leader appointed Mohsen Rezaei to head the Supreme National Security Council as Hormuz talks faltered and the UAE condemned an Iranian attack on a tanker linked to its state oil firm.

items.headline: Update: Houthis strike Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery as Gulf conflict widens
items.summary: Yemen's Houthis claimed a strike on Aramco's Jazan refinery days after wounding 11 in Najran, as the Pentagon asked US defence firms to ramp up munitions production.

items.headline: Microsoft plans a big production boost for its in-house AI chips
items.summary: Microsoft is in talks with TSMC to secure capacity for more than 300,000 next-generation AI accelerators for 2027, and will unveil its Maia 300 chip this autumn.

items.headline: TSMC's July sales jump 45% as AI-chip demand defies market jitters
items.summary: TSMC reported July revenue of NT$467.58 billion (about US$14.5 billion), up roughly 45% year on year, underscoring sustained AI-hardware demand.

items.headline: Wall Street slips from record highs as oil rises on Hormuz uncertainty
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Dow each fell about 0.1% and the Nasdaq lost 0.3% as oil climbed on Hormuz doubts, ahead of July CPI and PPI this week.

items.headline: Teledyne agrees to buy Varex Imaging; shares surge 48%
items.summary: Varex Imaging jumped about 48% after Teledyne Technologies agreed to acquire it for $18.90 a share in cash, with the deal expected to close in early 2027.

items.headline: Archer Aviation to acquire three Boeing subsidiaries as Boeing takes a stake
items.summary: Archer Aviation shares rose after it said it would buy three Boeing subsidiaries, with Boeing taking an undisclosed stake in the eVTOL company.

items.headline: Apple falls after Jefferies downgrades the stock to underperform
items.summary: Apple shares slid about 2% after Jefferies cut its rating to underperform from hold, weighing on the Dow ahead of inflation data.

items.headline: Toronto quarter-finals set as Gauff, Osaka, Rybakina and Swiatek advance
items.summary: Coco Gauff, Naomi Osaka, Elena Rybakina and Iga Swiatek reached the WTA 1000 Toronto last eight as Alexandra Eala's run ended against Belinda Bencic; semi-finals are Wednesday.

items.headline: Shelton beats Fonseca and Mensik advances as Montreal nears its final
items.summary: Defending champion Ben Shelton beat Joao Fonseca and Jakub Mensik defeated Botic van de Zandschulp at the men's National Bank Open in Montreal; the final is August 13.

items.headline: Southern Brave end Trent Rockets' winning run in The Hundred
items.summary: Southern Brave chased 159 with three balls to spare to beat Trent Rockets by six wickets at Trent Bridge; Tristan Stubbs made 52 not out off 28 balls.

items.headline: Trent Rockets women edge Southern Brave by three wickets
items.summary: Trent Rockets women chased 118 with two balls remaining to beat Southern Brave women by three wickets at Trent Bridge; Nat Sciver-Brunt made 32 from 19 balls.

items.headline: Ocon's Haas seat comes under threat in the 2027 driver market
items.summary: With F1 on its summer break before the Dutch Grand Prix (Aug 21-23), Esteban Ocon is not confirmed at Haas for 2027 after trailing team-mate Oliver Bearman through 2026.

items.headline: Total solar eclipse to sweep Iceland and Spain on August 12 - Europe's first since 1999
items.summary: Wednesday's total solar eclipse crosses Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain, the first over mainland Europe since 1999 and the first over Iberia in over a century; maximum totality is about 2 minutes 18 seconds.

fun_fact.headline: Cows have friends and get stressed when separated from them
fun_fact.body: Cows form close, lasting friendships and prefer specific companions in the herd. A University of Northampton study found cows penned with a preferred partner had lower heart rates and stress hormones than when placed beside a random herd-mate.
fun_fact.source: University of Northampton research; reported by New Scientist and BBC

puzzle.title: Two Candles
puzzle.body: Two candles start the same length but different thicknesses. The thin one burns fully in 4 hours, the thick one in 5 hours. Both lit together. After how long is the thick candle exactly twice as long as the thin one?
puzzle.approach: Write each length as a fraction shrinking at a steady rate, then set one equal to twice the other.
puzzle.answer: 3 hours 20 minutes (t = 10/3 h). Thin = 1 - t/4, thick = 1 - t/5; 1 - t/5 = 2(1 - t/4) gives t = 10/3 h. Check: thin = 1/6, thick = 1/3 = 2 x 1/6.

word_puzzle.title: Child's Play
word_puzzle.body: Sort 16 words into four groups of four: SURF, TAP, MOON, SWING, CARD, WALTZ, SUN, SEESAW, KEY, SALSA, SPOT, SLIDE, DASH, TANGO, DAY, SANDPIT.
word_puzzle.approach: Four hidden groups of four; watch for words that swing between two categories.
word_puzzle.answer: Precede LIGHT: MOON, SUN, SPOT, DAY. Dances: TAP, SALSA, WALTZ, TANGO. Precede BOARD: KEY, CARD, SURF, DASH. Playground: SLIDE, SWING, SEESAW, SANDPIT.
